description: Job Title: Lab Analyst Job Description The Lab Analyst plays a key role in a special analysis group, performing sample preparation, routine bench testing, and specialized chemical analytical testing. This role focuses on operating and maintaining laboratory instruments, preparing samples for advanced analytical methods, and accurately reporting results. The position offers extensive cross-training across multiple laboratory groups and provides an opportunity to grow from a developing lab technician into a high-level scientist or technologist through hands-on work with new instrumentation and methods. Responsibilities Perform sample preparation and routine bench testing using techniques such as spectrophotometry, conductivity measurements, fluoride analysis by ion selective electrode (ISE), and automated titrations. Prepare samples for ion chromatography (IC) and liquid chromatography (LC) analysis in accordance with established laboratory methods and protocols. Operate, monitor, and perform basic troubleshooting on laboratory instruments and equipment used in chemical analytical testing. Conduct specific chemical analytical testing in a production-focused laboratory environment while maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy. Record, interpret, and report test results clearly and accurately, ensuring documentation is complete, organized, and compliant with laboratory requirements. Use laboratory information management systems (LIMS) to enter, track, and manage sample and test data, supporting efficient workflow and data integrity. Follow quality control procedures, including monitoring laboratory control samples (LCS), managing rechecks and send-backs, and ensuring all testing meets quality performance standards. Meet established turnaround time (TAT) targets by organizing workload, prioritizing tasks, and working efficiently in a time-sensitive environment. Communicate test findings, issues, and updates promptly and professionally to relevant team members and stakeholders. Collaborate with colleagues in a dynamic team environment and participate in cross-training across a variety of laboratory groups to become a versatile jack of all trades. Apply sound decision-making skills and independent problem-solving to resolve routine laboratory issues and support continuous improvement. Maintain a clean, safe, and orderly laboratory workspace, following all applicable safety procedures and guidelines. Support method development, optimization, and implementation by learning new techniques, instrumentation, and analytical approaches as needed. Essential Skills Experience working in a production-oriented laboratory environment or strong interest in production laboratory work. Strong decision-making skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and make sound judgments in a fast-paced setting.
